about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples: the out-of-scope agent policy is refuse-and-offer-only (Pratik's ruling, row 501 item G, resolving night-1 triage rank 4's three-way question -- option (a), not the disclosed-approximation or enable-the-real-module options). Fix round 1 (Opus review finding 6): evaluate.py now READS the policy meta scenarios.py:agent_case writes (out_of_scope_policy/substitute_ok) and emits the ruling's own outcome name, unrequested_edit -- not the generic unexpected_edit -- and a bare refusal with no offered alternative (policy.offer_markers) scores needs_review, not a silent pass. Run by tests/intent/test_out_of_scope_policy_intent.py against the REAL generator's r0019 case (an actual out-of-scope request), not a hand-built one. Two oracles per example: the verdict's `score` (pass/partial/fail) and its `outcome` label.
